page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-32-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 32 dedicated virtual CPUs and 252.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per vCPU core. This hardware configuration does not include graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its dedicated CPU allocation, the instance ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention from neighboring tenants. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio positions this server as a memory-optimized resource, offering a dense memory configuration relative to its processing cores. This profile provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require substantial memory capacity but do not scale linearly with excessive CPU core counts, optimizing licensing and resource costs.

The c4d-highmem-32-lssd is designed for memory-intensive applications. Suitable workloads include in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise applications, data analytics, and memory-heavy backend services that benefit from a dedicated x86_64 processing environment.
